div.head: Af El. 33
div.ab: Utan cumene ⁊ ælþeodige ne geswænc þu ðone, forþam ðe ge wæron ælþeodige on Egypta lande.
Utan cumene ⁊ elðeodige ne geswenc ðu no, forðon ðe ge wæron giu elðeodige on Egipta londe.
Aduenam non contristabis neque affliges eum; aduenæ enim et ipsi fuistis in terra Egypti.
Utan cumene ⁊ elðeodige ne geswenc ðu no, forðon ðe ge wæron giu elðeodige on Egipta londe.
Do not oppress those come from afar and foreigners, because you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.
Von auswärts gekommene und Fremde bedrücke du nicht; weil ihr einst Fremde waret im Ägypter Lande.
Do not oppress those who have come from outside and strangers; for you were once strangers in the land of the Egyptians.
